title: Bendy in Nightmare Run
description:
While working at Karman Interactive, I had the great pleasure of building Bendy in Nightmare Run, an endless runner mobile game spin-off of Bendy and the Ink Machine.

![](/assets/projects/career/bendy-in-nightmare-run/screenshot-1.webp)

This is the most fun I've had making a game (as of 2026), as it was a small team, I was involved from start to finish, and we had a huge amount of creative freedom.

![Screenshot image 9](assets/projects/career/bendy-in-nightmare-run/screenshot-2.webp)![Screenshot image 7](assets/projects/career/bendy-in-nightmare-run/screenshot-3.webp)

Building an intuitive UI and making interesting visual effects without any color was a fun challenge. Attempting to play game designer was new and uncomfortable to me, as we were left to define the mechanics and playtest them as we saw fit, but I think we ended up with a genuinely fun game!

![Screenshot image 8](assets/projects/career/bendy-in-nightmare-run/screenshot-4.webp)![Screenshot image 10](assets/projects/career/bendy-in-nightmare-run/screenshot-5.webp)

The game was still mobile freemium, but we strove to make the mechanics interesting and the in-app purchases unobtrusive.
